description: SISTERS, OR- Today, Deschutes County Commissioner and candidate for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District, Patti Adair, called on Congresswoman Janelle Bynum to set the record straight on her position on socialism and the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA). Commissioner Adair stated the following:“On November 21st, Janelle Bynum voted present on a House resolution to condemn socialism.
